title: Minion: A Technology Probe to Explore How Users Negotiate Harmful Value Conflicts with AI Companions
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on secular value conflicts in human-AI companion interactions, such as those involving power dynamics, social norms, identity, and personal boundaries.
